status: registered; shortened integration must precede governed-hour dispatch
initialization: zero measurement and mask weights; gas bias +1, brake bias -1; no trained parent
actor_history_use: current features plus angular-rate feature; earlier vectors are logged but not direct linear-head inputs
action_space: independent gas and brake logits; four joint states available
score: Two agreeing fresh terminal distance readings >=0.15s apart, or a valid displayed-progress read at the verified paused boundary after the full 60s collection horizon; unknown scores ineligible. Release-to-pause delay included in paused endpoint.
selection: reevaluate incumbent and distribution mean in each generation; update only after all eight eligible candidates
partial_generation: retain candidate state and measured costs; no distribution update
transfer_claim: none; this policy is trained on an explicitly different observable feature schema
external_learning_overlap: separately recorded surrogate reproduction and post-hour experiments may share the workstation
dispatch_requirements: versioned UI, glyph, measurement and feature profiles
numeric_failure: After twelve attempts or three seconds without agreement, retain unknown numeric score and permit only independently confirmed result dismissal. Three consecutive ineligible candidates stop the pilot/session.
episode_selection: One first episode per candidate attempt; deterministic observed level start, no public game seed control. Learner RNG alone is seeded.
qualification_gate: Independent real evaluation: median >=500m, >=3x random median, and >=8/10 episodes reaching250m; provisional operational gate, no human-expert claim.

engineering_evidence.result_label_limitation: 203 source-disjoint but manual label not blinded to OCR; one unique frame/episode
